newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down four cents to 15.09 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down four cents to 15.09 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell four cents to 15.09 ringgit ($6.04) a kg despite a higher close on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday, traders said.
"There were many high offerings today and the market did not take its cue from the LME," said a dealer. The LME rose $25 on Friday.

Turnover rose to 155 tonnes from 108 on Friday. Bids totalled 146 tonnes against offers of 170. Dealers said Malaysian tin was trading at a rare discount of $30 a tonne to the LME against a premium of $10 on Friday.
